usage: Accord de matières : Bord de piscine
prompt:
A designer's material composition titled in spirit « Bord de piscine »: real samples of Pierre de Bourgogne, Teck, Tadelakt arranged together as an interior architect's still life, in the proportion Pierre en margelle · teck en mobilier · enduit sur les murets. Mood: Villa du Sud, eau turquoise.
Editorial still-life photograph for an interior design magazine, 85 mm lens, close framing where the material fills most of the frame, soft raking daylight from the side that reveals the texture, natural depth of field, true colour, no blown highlights.
LOCKS: no brand, no logo, no label, no text, no people.
